lead.title: DV360 branding requirement takes effect today
lead.deck: Check parent-advertiser business name and logo defaults before uploading YouTube responsive ads through Structured Data Files.

note: The lead is an official integration requirement effective today. Profound's 11 October release is the newest product announcement. Earlier developments are clearly dated; vendor-reported results are not presented as independent guarantees.
ticker: Meesho reports AI across commerce operations
Tinuiti opens measurement data to compatible agents

stories.title: Business name and logo required for certain YouTube responsive ad uploads
stories.summary: WHAT: From 12 October, Google's developer notice requires a business name and logo if parent-advertiser defaults are absent. WHY: Bulk uploads may fail. USE: Audit advertiser defaults and test a small batch. STATUS: Confirmed official requirement.

stories.title: Display & Video 360 Structured Data Files v11 is generally available
stories.summary: WHAT: Google's 8 October release expands lookalike targeting, adds Business Chain proximity targeting and updates YouTube vendor columns. WHY: Bulk-trafficking templates may need updates; versions before v10 are deprecated and scheduled to sunset in January 2027. USE: Test uploads and update column mappings. STATUS: Official release.

stories.title: Profound introduces Dynamic Bot Rendering for AI crawlers
stories.summary: WHAT: On 11 October, Profound announced rendered page delivery for supported AI bots when content is hidden behind JavaScript or interactions. WHY: Crawlers may miss product and comparison details. USE: Compare bot and human views, verify content and policy compliance, then monitor crawl logs. STATUS: Vendor announcement; citations are not guaranteed.

stories.title: Meta expands creative studio, campaign-assistant tests and AI video tools
stories.summary: WHAT: Meta's 6 October update describes broader Ads Creative Studio access, AI video generation and tests for assistant-led campaign workflows. WHY: Creative iteration may speed up, while availability varies by feature. USE: Test image-to-video variations and retain approvals for budgets, targeting and publishing. STATUS: Official Meta announcement.

stories.title: Meta blocks ByteDance and TikTok-linked ads in seven markets
stories.summary: WHAT: Reuters reported on 8 October that Meta barred ByteDance ads in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam, including third-party ads linking to TikTok properties there. WHY: Campaigns may be rejected in affected markets. USE: Audit destinations by country and prepare alternatives; do not assume the restriction is global. STATUS: Reuters report citing Meta.

stories.title: Meesho's FY26 disclosures show AI across discovery, ads and voice commerce
stories.summary: WHAT: An Express Computer analysis published 10 October describes Meesho's AI stack for discovery, advertising, fraud prevention and support, plus voice shopping agent Vaani and seller agent Chorus. WHY: AI is being embedded across commerce operations, not just chat. USE: Test regional-language voice discovery and measure conversion, returns and support cost against a control group. STATUS: Secondary reporting from company disclosures; results are company-reported.

stories.title: Tinuiti opens cross-channel measurement data to compatible AI agents via MCP
stories.summary: WHAT: Tinuiti announced its Bliss Point MCP Server on 6 October, exposing approved normalized media and measurement data to compatible AI tools, subject to client permissions. WHY: A unified data layer can reduce manual reconciliation. USE: Start with read-only pacing summaries and anomaly alerts; validate outputs against platform reports. STATUS: Vendor announcement; access depends on permissions.
